function sweetdream:tag/identity
$data modify storage zx:tag owner.expected set value $(expected)
$data modify storage zx:tag owner.count set value $(count)
$data modify storage zx:tag owner.glyphs set value $(glyphs)
$data modify storage zx:tag owner.case set value "$(case)"
function sweetdream:debug/tag_test/check_go with storage zx:tag owner
scoreboard players add #tag_checks zx.meta 1
$execute store result score #tag_actual zx.meta run execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:text_display,tag=zx.icon_v2,tag=zx.owner_$(u0)_$(u1)_$(u2)_$(u3)]
$execute unless score #tag_actual zx.meta matches $(count) run function sweetdream:debug/tag_test/fail {case:"$(case): entity count"}

$execute if score #tag_actual zx.meta matches 1 unless score @e[type=minecraft:text_display,tag=zx.icon_v2,tag=zx.owner_$(u0)_$(u1)_$(u2)_$(u3),limit=1] zx.icon_mask matches $(expected) run function sweetdream:debug/tag_test/fail {case:"$(case): state mask"}
scoreboard players set #tag_glyphs zx.meta 0

$execute if score #tag_actual zx.meta matches 1 store result score #tag_glyphs zx.meta run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:text_display,tag=zx.icon_v2,tag=zx.owner_$(u0)_$(u1)_$(u2)_$(u3),limit=1] text.extra
$execute unless score #tag_glyphs zx.meta matches $(glyphs) run function sweetdream:debug/tag_test/fail {case:"$(case): glyph count"}
$tag @e[type=minecraft:text_display,tag=zx.icon_v2,tag=zx.owner_$(u0)_$(u1)_$(u2)_$(u3)] add zx.tag_test_icon
$summon minecraft:text_display ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["zx.icon","zx.icon_v2","zx.tag_test_icon","zx.owner_$(u0)_$(u1)_$(u2)_$(u3)"],text:{text:"duplicate"}}
scoreboard players add #tag_fail zx.meta 1
$data modify storage zx:tag_test failures append value "$(case)"
$tellraw @a {text:"[标签自检 FAIL] $(case)",color:"red"}
execute store result score #tag_y zx.meta run data get entity @s Pos[1] 1000
$execute store result score #tag_iy zx.meta run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:text_display,tag=zx.icon_v2,tag=zx.owner_$(u0)_$(u1)_$(u2)_$(u3),limit=1] Pos[1] 1000
scoreboard players operation #tag_iy zx.meta -= #tag_y zx.meta
execute unless score #tag_iy zx.meta matches 1200..1400 run function sweetdream:debug/tag_test/fail {case:"eyes anchor height"}
kill @e[tag=zx.tag_test_icon]
kill @e[type=minecraft:pig,tag=zx.tag_test]
scoreboard players set #tag_fail zx.meta 0
scoreboard players set #tag_checks zx.meta 0
data modify storage zx:tag_test failures set value []
data modify storage zx:tag_test saved_input set from storage zx:work ic

summon minecraft:pig ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["zx.tag_test","zx.tag_test_a"],NoAI:1b,NoGravity:1b,Silent:1b,Invulnerable:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,DeathLootTable:"minecraft:empty",active_effects:[{id:"minecraft:invisibility",amplifier:0,duration:200,show_particles:0b}]}
